statusVocabulary.designed: Written into governance; nothing executes it yet.
statusVocabulary.implemented: Generated into every instance and statically checked, but the behaviour itself has not been observed.
statusVocabulary.verified: An automated check, or a recorded run, demonstrates it. Verified rows MUST carry evidence.

evidenceKinds.check: A named check in validate-harness.ps1 or tests/ that fails when the control breaks.
evidenceKinds.ci: A specific CI run whose log is the proof.
evidenceKinds.run: A recorded manual execution, with date and result in docs/harness/implementation-log.md.

controls.control: GitHub authority verbs (merge, approve, gh api/secret/repo/workflow) are hard-denied to agents

evidence.ref: validate-harness.ps1 config:policies
implementation-log 2026-11-10: N-05 gh pr merge denied (Permission denied: shell) on OpenCode 2.2.6; the policy rule is statically asserted and the policy precedence is proven by VC-11

controls.control: The policies layer is evaluated after permissions, saved approvals and agent rules, so a role cannot re-open a hard deny

evidence.ref: implementation-log 2026-11-10: an explicit agent permission allow for shell:npm publish* was overridden by the policy hard-deny (Blocked by configuration policy) on OpenCode 2.2.6

controls.notes: Decisive test: the developer agent was given an explicit `allow` for `npm publish*`, and the policy still blocked the call with 'Blocked by configuration policy' - the policy layer is evaluated after the agent rule. This is the precedence the whole design rests on (ADR-H-004).
